//overrides: js-cookie is pulled in by @clerk/backend v1 -> @clerk/shared v3, which pins the exact 3.0.5 that GHSA-qjx8-664m-686j covers. No 3.x of @clerk/shared moves off it; the fix only lands in @clerk/shared 4.13.1, and reaching that from here means @clerk/backend 1 -> 3, two majors across token verification, user/session management and org provisioning. That bump is worth doing on its own, with a live Clerk instance to test against. Meanwhile the advisory is a prototype hijack in js-cookie's assign() reached through document.cookie writes, and nothing writes a document cookie in a Node process, so the override is here to pin the patched 3.0.7 (API-identical) and close the alert rather than to fix a reachable bug. Drop it when @clerk/backend moves to 3.x.
